Interim Financial Statements for the Quarter ended 30th June 2026

financials_interim.notes: Same source as GROUP row (source_id 52467), Company column of the same statements: P&L p.6 (doc p.07), Balance Sheet p.8 (doc p.09), Cash Flow p.10 (doc p.11). Company (standalone, i.e. the Energy/LPG-cylinder distribution business only, excluding the Trading-segment subsidiary/entity whose revenue collapse drove the Group number) revenue was essentially FLAT YoY: Rs.6,012,880k vs Rs.5,983,889k PY (+0.5%) -- confirms the core LPG distribution business itself did not deteriorate; the Group-level 50% revenue decline is entirely a Trading-segment/consolidation effect (see GROUP row notes). Company Foreign Currency Exchange Gains/(Losses) swung more sharply than Group: Rs.(26,981)k loss vs Rs.46,104k gain PY, a Rs.73,085k unfavourable swing -- larger in the Company than at Group level, consistent with LGL's LPG import book (USD-denominated) sitting mostly at the parent/Company level. Company Operating Profit fell 76% YoY to Rs.124,484k (2025: Rs.510,049k) on flat revenue -- driven by the FX swing (~Rs.73,085k of the ~Rs.385,565k operating-profit decline) plus a 12% rise in Administrative Expenses (244,171 vs 217,378) and a smaller (7%) rise in Cost of Sales outpacing the flat revenue, compressing gross margin from 13.5% (807,103/5,983,889) to 7.9% (472,685/6,012,880) -- gross margin compression, not a revenue collapse, is the Company-level story, in contrast to the Group's revenue-collapse story. Company swung from a PBT PROFIT of Rs.133,598k PY to a PBT LOSS of Rs.(214,822)k this quarter (-261%), and PAT swung from a Rs.19,632k profit to a Rs.(233,598)k loss (-1,290%). eps_basic=eps_diluted=-0.60 (PY: +0.05). Cross-check: -233,598k / 387,000,086 shares = -0.6037, rounds to disclosed -0.60. minority_interest not applicable (Company is the standalone parent, no consolidation, so left at 0). trade_receivables = 'Trade and Other Receivables' (3,285,139k), trade_payables = 'Trade and Other Payables' (2,912,400k) -- same disclosure-gap caveat as GROUP row (no finer trade/non-trade split given). Company Total Equity remains solidly positive at Rs.20,765,772k (Net Assets Per Share Rs.53.66) despite the quarterly loss -- unlike the Group figure, because at Company level 'Investments in Subsidiaries' of Rs.24,707,988k (carried at cost, not consolidated/loss-making subsidiary value written down) sits on the balance sheet rather than the subsidiaries' own accumulated losses. capex = Acquisition of PP&E (31,383k) per Company cash flow statement.

Source: LAUGFS Gas PLC interim FS for quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 (signed 13 Aug 2026, unaudited/subject to audit). This is LGL's first financial_statements entry -- no prior period in this DB, hence no QoQ possible regardless. Consolidated P&L p.1 (doc p.02), Balance Sheet p.3 (doc p.04), Cash Flow p.5 (doc p.06), Segmental Reporting note p.11 (doc p.12). HEADLINE: Group revenue collapsed 50% YoY (Rs.6,035,521k vs Rs.12,059,971k) purely because the Trading segment (bulk/wholesale LPG trading, distinct from the core Energy/cylinder-distribution segment) had ZERO external revenue this quarter vs Rs.6,049,624k a year ago (segmental note p.11/doc p.12) -- Energy segment external revenue (=Company revenue) was flat, +0.5% YoY (6,012,880 vs 5,983,889). The Trading segment's total revenue including inter-segment (which nets out on consolidation) also fell to zero from Rs.10,980,461k PY. No qualitative commentary is given anywhere in the filing on WHY Trading segment revenue went to zero -- flagged as a genuine disclosure gap (no cylinder-pricing-formula or LPG-import-cost commentary is given either; the filing contains only the standard LKAS 34 numeric statements, no MD&A/chairman's commentary). Foreign Currency Exchange Gains/(Losses) swung to a Rs.18,067k LOSS from a Rs.33,208k GAIN PY (a Rs.51,275k unfavourable swing, consistent with LGL's USD-denominated LPG import exposure) -- quantified as a driver of the deeper loss but not large enough alone to explain the operating-profit collapse; the collapse is revenue-driven (Trading segment), not margin-driven (Group gross margin actually held up: 507,287/6,035,521 = 8.4% vs 888,296/12,059,971 = 7.4% PY). Operating profit fell 82% to Rs.93,493k (2025: Rs.525,160k) despite the margin resilience, purely on the smaller revenue base plus the FX swing and a 16% rise in Administrative Expenses (319,026 vs 275,690). Group PBT loss widened to Rs.(547,392)k from Rs.(187,131)k PY (-193%), and PAT loss widened to Rs.(572,916)k from Rs.(313,273)k PY (-83%). Finance Costs of Rs.662,194k (down 10% YoY) remain the single largest P&L line after cost of sales, on Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings of Rs.36,890,559k combined (current+non-current) at 30 June 2026. minority_interest=4,988k (NCI's share of the period profit; NCI itself was profitable even as the Group as a whole posted a loss attributable to equity holders of Rs.(577,904)k). eps_basic=eps_diluted=-1.49, disclosed as a single combined 'Basic/Diluted Earnings/(Loss) Per Share' line (no separate diluted figure or dilutive instruments). Cross-check: -577,904k / 387,000,086 shares (Note 4.6: 335,000,086 voting + 52,000,000 non-voting) = -1.4934, rounds to disclosed -1.49. Balance sheet: total_liabilities is not a single printed line -- computed as Non-Current Liabilities (21,818,581) + Current Liabilities (27,476,672) = 49,295,253k (cross-checks against Total Assets 48,030,860 minus Total Equity (1,264,394) = 48,030,860+1,264,394 = 49,295,254k, a Rs.1k rounding difference, immaterial). Group Total Equity is NEGATIVE (Rs.(1,264,394)k) -- accumulated losses of Rs.(8,201,513)k have exceeded Stated Capital + Revaluation + FX reserves; Net Assets Per Share is Rs.(4.97), printed on the face of the balance sheet, consistent with this. trade_receivables mapped to 'Trade and Other Receivables' (4,543,628k) -- the only receivables line disclosed, includes some non-trade items per the caption, no finer split given. trade_payables mapped similarly to 'Trade and Other Payables' (6,549,214k). short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings map to the current/non-current 'Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings' lines. capex = Acquisition of PP&E per cash flow statement (31,833k); Proceeds from Disposal of PP&E (22,161k) not netted in, kept as gross capex outflow. cash_from_operations is deeply negative (-2,079,518k) despite an operating PROFIT before working capital changes of 758,224k, because of a Rs.3,254,954k build-up in Inventories this quarter (LPG stock, likely tied to the Trading-segment revenue drop -- goods bought but not yet sold/invoiced -- though the filing does not state this explicitly, another disclosure gap) plus Rs.662,194k of Finance Costs Paid and Rs.107,148k Income Tax Paid.

interim_updates.note_text: LAUGFS Gas PLC (LGL) reported a Group Revenue collapse of 50% YoY to Rs.6,035.52mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), down from Rs.12,059.97mn in Q1 FY2025/26 -- driven ENTIRELY by the Trading segment (bulk/wholesale LPG trading), whose external revenue fell to ZERO this quarter from Rs.6,049.62mn a year ago (Segmental Reporting note), while the core Energy segment (cylinder distribution, = Company-level revenue) was essentially flat, +0.5% YoY to Rs.6,012.88mn. No explanation for the Trading segment's revenue disappearance is given anywhere in the filing -- a genuine and material disclosure gap. Group Gross Profit margin actually held up (8.4% vs 7.4% PY), so the operating-profit decline (-82% YoY to Rs.93.49mn from Rs.525.16mn) is a pure volume/scale effect from the Trading-segment loss, compounded by a swing in Foreign Currency Exchange Gains/(Losses) from a Rs.33.21mn GAIN to an Rs.18.07mn LOSS (a Rs.51.28mn unfavourable swing, consistent with LGL's USD-denominated LPG import exposure) and a 16% rise in Administrative Expenses (Rs.319.03mn vs Rs.275.69mn). Group PBT loss widened to Rs.(547.39)mn from Rs.(187.13)mn PY (-193%), and PAT loss widened to Rs.(572.92)mn from Rs.(313.27)mn PY (-83%); Basic/Diluted EPS worsened to Rs.(1.49) from Rs.(0.82). Income Tax Expense fell 80% YoY to Rs.25.52mn (2025: Rs.126.14mn), consistent with the much larger pretax loss. At the Company (standalone, Energy-segment-only) level the picture is different: revenue was flat (+0.5%) but PBT swung from a Rs.133.60mn PROFIT to a Rs.(214.82)mn LOSS (-261%) and PAT from Rs.19.63mn profit to Rs.(233.60)mn loss (-1,290%), driven by a sharper FX swing (Rs.46.10mn gain to Rs.26.98mn loss, a Rs.73.09mn unfavourable move -- larger than at Group level, indicating LGL's USD import book sits mainly at the parent) plus gross margin compression from 13.5% to 7.9% on a 7% rise in Cost of Sales against flat revenue. Group finance costs of Rs.662.19mn (down 10% YoY) remain a heavy drag on an Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings base of Rs.36,890.56mn (current+non-current combined). Group Total Equity is NEGATIVE at Rs.(1,264.39)mn (Net Assets Per Share Rs.(4.97)), driven by accumulated losses of Rs.(8,201.51)mn exceeding Stated Capital and reserves; Company-level equity remains solidly positive at Rs.20,765.77mn (NAV/share Rs.53.66) because Investments in Subsidiaries are carried at cost, not consolidated loss-adjusted value.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is LGL's first financial_statements/interim_updates entry in this DB (no closer prior quarter has been collected). Genuine filing-level gaps: (1) no qualitative commentary/MD&A anywhere in the filing explains WHY Trading-segment external revenue fell to zero (Rs.6,049.62mn PY to Rs.0 this quarter) -- this is the single largest driver of the headline Group revenue decline and cannot be further explained from the document; (2) no commentary on LPG cylinder pricing formula/regulatory pricing changes is given despite LGL's exposure to CEB/government LPG pricing policy -- a common qualitative driver for LK LPG distributors that this filing simply does not address; (3) Group total_liabilities is not printed as a single line and was computed as Non-Current (21,818,581k) + Current (27,476,672k) Liabilities = 49,295,253k, which cross-checks to within Rs.1k of Total Assets less Total Equity; (4) the large Rs.3,254.95mn Group Inventory build this quarter is not explained qualitatively -- plausibly tied to the Trading-segment revenue collapse (stock bought but not sold/invoiced) but this is inference, not disclosed fact.
interim_updates.takeaway: LGL's headline 50% YoY Group revenue collapse and widening losses are a consolidation/Trading-segment story, not a core-business story: the Energy segment (=Company standalone), which is the actual LPG-cylinder distribution business, held revenue flat YoY. The real deterioration at the Company level was margin compression (13.5% to 7.9% gross margin) plus an unfavourable Rs.73.09mn FX swing on USD-denominated LPG imports, which together flipped a Rs.133.60mn PBT profit into a Rs.(214.82)mn PBT loss. The Trading segment's complete loss of external revenue (Rs.6,049.62mn to zero) is unexplained in the filing and is the single largest number to watch/query going into the next quarter -- if it is a one-off cessation of a bulk-trading contract rather than a recurring pattern, the Group-level YoY comparison should normalise; if it recurs, Group revenue will remain structurally smaller than the FY2025/26 base. Group Total Equity turning negative is also worth flagging for balance-sheet-covenant risk given Rs.36.89bn of combined interest-bearing debt.
operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.6,035.52mn, -50% YoY (2025: Rs.12,059.97mn); Group Operating profit Rs.93.49mn, -82% YoY; Group PBT loss widened to Rs.(547.39)mn (2025: Rs.(187.13)mn); Group PAT loss widened to Rs.(572.92)mn (2025: Rs.(313.27)mn).

Trading segment external revenue fell to ZERO this quarter from Rs.6,049.62mn PY (Segmental note) -- the sole driver of the Group revenue collapse; Energy segment (=Company) external revenue flat, +0.5% YoY to Rs.6,012.88mn.

Group Foreign Currency Exchange Gains/(Losses) swung to an Rs.18.07mn LOSS from a Rs.33.21mn GAIN PY, a Rs.51.28mn unfavourable swing tied to USD-denominated LPG imports; Company-level FX swing was larger, Rs.46.10mn gain to Rs.26.98mn loss (Rs.73.09mn unfavourable).
Company (standalone) swung from a Rs.133.60mn PBT profit to a Rs.(214.82)mn PBT loss (-261% YoY) despite flat revenue, on gross margin compression from 13.5% to 7.9%.

Group Total Equity is negative, Rs.(1,264.39)mn (Net Assets Per Share Rs.(4.97)), vs a positive Rs.2,448.73mn a year earlier; Company-level equity remains positive at Rs.20,765.77mn (NAV/share Rs.53.66).
Group Finance Costs Rs.662.19mn (-10% YoY) on Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings of Rs.36,890.56mn combined current+non-current.
key_drivers: Trading segment external revenue collapse to zero (from Rs.6,049.62mn PY) is the sole driver of the 50% Group revenue decline -- no cause disclosed in the filing (genuine gap).
FX loss swing of Rs.51.28mn (Group) / Rs.73.09mn (Company) on LGL's USD-denominated LPG import exposure, widening both Group and Company losses.

Company-level gross margin compression from 13.5% to 7.9% (Cost of Sales +7% against flat revenue) is the main driver of the Company PBT swing from profit to loss, distinct from the Group's revenue-driven story.

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
